description.en: Reads the current RPG (free-roam) camera's position and reference (look-at) point, computed relative to the player character.
A 6-element array [posX, posY, posZ, refX, refY, refZ] with the camera's position and reference point.

example.code:
// Read the current RPG camera's position and reference point
local camPosRef = GetRpgCameraPos();
